newsitem.title: BOSNIA: Malaysian officer dies in Bosnia road accident.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian officer dies in Bosnia road accident.

text.p: A NATO spokesman said on Monday that a Malaysian military officer was killed and a second officer injured in a road accident in Bosnia.

Colonel Azizan Bin Ahmad, deputy commander of Malaysian troops serving in the NATO-led peace Stabilisation Force (SFOR), was killed when his vehicle collided with a Land Rover driven by British soldiers, spokesman Major Tony White said.

The accident occurred early on Sunday morning in thick fog near the western town of Glamoc, White said. The second Malaysian officer was taken to hospital for treatment and the two British soldiers suffered light injuries.
Last Friday, a civilian was killed when his car collided with an SFOR armoured personnel carrier near the central town of Visoko.
